name: version-compare
title: Version Compare
description: A document's version history at full size — the selected version (or its changes through DiffView) beside a day-grouped VersionList on resizable panels, with Restore and Copy pinned in a footer; on a phone the list first and the preview pushed in.

meta.whenToUse: A document's full history in DialogContent size="fullscreen": read a version or its changes beside the list, and restore or copy it.
meta.whenNotToUse: A short history beside a page (VersionList alone), an activity feed (Timeline), or comparing two arbitrary texts (DiffView).
